summary.title: NUH Pseudonymised Patient Demographics
summary.abstract: Pseudonymised demographic data for patients of Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust, including sex, gender identity, month of birth, date of death, ethnicity, marital status, religion, nationality and Lower Layer Super Output Area. Intended for linkage with NUH clinical research datasets.

documentation.description: One row per patient, pseudonymised for research use. Dates of birth are given as the first of the month, and home postcode is replaced by the Lower Layer Super Output Area. Coded fields (sex, gender identity, ethnicity, marital status, religion) are provided as both a code and its description, following the NHS Data Dictionary where one exists. Records carry ETL and pipeline run metadata. Access requires a data access request.
